scope: HyperX QuadCast 2S (9A273AA) only: (1) re-fetch the official product page to compare against Stage 11's saved snapshot and verify the corrected 14-item gallery extraction still holds, (2) check the user-provided video URL's type/availability and fetch its cover image with evidence, separately. No other product, no brand census.

host_reasoning.cdn.shopify.com: NEW this stage. Added only because the user-provided video URL (https://cdn.shopify.com/videos/c/o/v/b05b09498da44727be948864df7222ac.mp4) was found, offline, embedded verbatim inside the already-saved, official hyperx.com product page's own <video><source> markup, under the same Shopify section-template id family as the confirmed 14-image gallery. This is first-party DOM linkage evidence, not an assumption from sharing a generic CDN. Scope is limited to this exact video file URL -- no other cdn.shopify.com path is fetched or assumed related.

limits.video_check_note: The video file itself is not downloaded in full -- only a small bounded Range request (first 64KB) is made to confirm reachability, HTTP status, Content-Type, and (if the server discloses it via Content-Range) total size. This is a type/availability check, not a content-language or visual-content verification, and is reported as such.

robots_txt_policy: hyperx.com/robots.txt already checked in Stage 11.1 (no rule covers /products/ or /cdn/shop/files/); not re-fetched. cdn.shopify.com/robots.txt is fetched fresh before the video request, since this host has never been checked before this stage.
stop_conditions: HTTP 403/429/challenge_confirmed on either host -> stop that host, record the gap
redirect off hyperx.com or cdn.shopify.com -> aborted, not followed
robots.txt disallows the exact video/page path -> skip, record why
if the official site cannot supply a needed field after this bounded check, stop searching further and prepare a short question for the user instead of continuing indefinitely
explicit_non_goals: No dealer/reseller sources without first determining a specific domain and its allowed brand/category (Sulpak's LG-home-appliance allowlist does not cover HyperX peripherals, so no dealer fallback applies to this product without a new, explicit domain decision)
No downloading the full video file
